authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No Alicia Masters: her reset would undo intentional gifts (L47).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Opponents remove a gifted Demonic Pact or Coil before it kills.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Swan Song, Withering Torment, Deadly Rollick, Chaos Warp, Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act, Cyclonic Rift, Vandalblast.
value.mana: 35 lands including Forbidden Orchard and Homeward Path; Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Signets, Talismans.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Sol'Kanar is repeatable end-step value, and his fourth mode is a political gift.
accepted_role.honest_note: Honest call: significant, not central. All four Spellbook combos (Demonic Pact + Donate / Harmless Offering / Blim / Coveted Falcon) work without him. He adds value through blink resets but the kills are the cursed-gift package. The source calls the plan slower and more board-dependent than cEDH (blueprint L22).
